title: Inventory Value for today lists a renamed part under its new number
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Reports View. Data: QAPL-T3 (tracked with stock at Staging Heavy Duty, present before today so yesterday's nightly snapshot holds it). The new number QAPL-T3-RN is not in use.
custom_steps:
1. Reports > Inventory Value (/reports/inventory-value): Staging Heavy Duty, As-of today > Run; find QAPL-T3 and note its Qty, Total Cost and the totals.
  2. Parts > Inventory > open QAPL-T3 > Part Number "QAPL-T3-RN" > Save.
  3. Reports > Inventory Value (/reports/inventory-value): Staging Heavy Duty, As-of today > Run again.
  4. Export (button_iv_export) > CSV, then PDF.
  5. Set As-of to yesterday (a date captured before the rename) > Run.
  6. Restore: Inventory > open QAPL-T3-RN > Part Number "QAPL-T3" > Save.
custom_expected:
1. QAPL-T3 is listed; Qty, Total Cost and totals noted.
  2. The part is renamed in place.
  3. The row reads QAPL-T3-RN with the same Qty and Total Cost as in step 1; there is no QAPL-T3 row; the totals are unchanged.
  4. Both files list QAPL-T3-RN with the same Qty and Total Cost and no QAPL-T3 row.
  5. The row reads QAPL-T3, the number as it was on that date.
  6. The part reads QAPL-T3 again.
